updates.title: [Game Update] - 728321
updates.content_text:
Small hotfix to address some concerns that have cropped up.
Bug Fixes
Fixed certain projectiles getting stuck on physics and staying around longer than intended.
Fixed an issue with server side handling of slash commands.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 727204
updates.content_text:
Changes
WX-78 may now Transfer Consciousness in and out of the Sanctum and the Sanctum Lobby.
Bug Fixes
Fixed Mimicked items never reverting over time after being dropped in a container.
Fixed WX-78 Backup Chassis losing ownership when being cursed into Wonkey.
Fixed Powder Monkeys not disengaging from fighting a player transitioning to or from Wonkey.
Fixed not dropping Implanted items when turning into Wonkey.
Fixed a crash sometimes when burning Evergreens are destroyed after going off-screen.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 726875
updates.content_text:
Bug Fixes
Fixed creatures like Chester that follow a carried item still following the holder of the item when the item is dropped from a distance.
Fixed crash when using shift-click to transfer items out of containers like Expansive Storage Unit, Ammo Pouch, Battle Call Canister, Picnic Casket, etc.
Fixed client prediction sometimes failing after transforming into Wonkey.
Fixed Exploiterators and Auto-Grabbers stopping from following WX-78 after minigames.
Fixed mutating Puffins being invisible.
Fixed Possessed Chassis getting stuck when they’re unable to find a suitable spot to attack.
Fixed Possessed Chassis trying to use Zaptrocuter on creatures that can’t be hit by its projectile.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 726747
updates.content_text:
Changes
Auto-Grabber can now deposit matching items into Expansive Storage Units (activated via Spatializer Circuits).
Expansive Storage Units now inherit WX-78’s preserver rates from active Refrigerant and Thermal Circuits.
Blocking Circuit ability will protect against thief sources such as Frogs, Bearger, Powder Monkey, Otter, etc.
Other players’ Exploiterators will now appear faded out if there are too many WX-78 players using them on your screen.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Auto-Grabber’s range boost needing Warm Standby even when following WX-78.
Fixed Possessed Chassis trying to walk forward to its target when waiting for projectiles to return to the Gloomerang.
Fixed Possessed Chassis sometimes crashing when their leader tries to row.
Fixed Cookie Cutters phasing through a boat when electrocuted as they land.
Fixed WX-78s Electrification Circuit skill perk electric attack being able to arc to other players when PVP is not enabled.
Fixed Shadow-Aligned WX-78 unable to Implant or Consume shadow items while riding a Beefalo.
Fixed Possessed Chassis being stunned by the Tail o’ Three Cats super crack.
Fixed Possessed Chassis weapons reverting to full (instead of half) durability cost after spinning.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not reaching their target when spinning.
Fixed Transfer Consciousness action being shown to characters other than WX-78.
Fixed equipped items on a Backup Chassis reverting back to a Mimicreep when reloading.
Fixed items reverting back to Mimicreeps automatically after some time even when a Possessed Shadow Atrium is Implanted.
Fixed inconsistent drain when using either Winona’s Generator or G.E.M.erator to recharge WX-78.
Fixed Zaptrocuter projectiles sometimes getting stuck in the air.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 725977
updates.content_text:
Hey Everybody!
Today we have a small Follow-Up Shadow Affinity update for the WX-78 Skill spotlight.
Highlights Include:
Added a new Chessmaster Circuit.
Added the Shadow Servitor skill for WX-78.
Replaced Field Survey II skill with Signal Booster skill, which boosts all drone ranges in general.
Roto-Mapper now also functions similar to Ocuvigil, but only revealed to the owner.
Additional behaviour and interactions for the Possessed Chassis.
Login Rewards
 
 
We're also including some login rewards for you. Get the Ominous Exploiterator, Gloomy Auto-Grabber, Elegant Exploiterator, Opulent Auto-Grabber and Pengull Ice Cube just by logging into the game for a limited time. The drone skins will later be purchasable in-game. 
Until Next time!
As mentioned in the WX-Spotlight update, we're moving on to the next batch of content for you. Note that this update is not on the previously released roadmap and is considered part of the WX-78 Spotlight update. So we still have quite a bit coming up. See you next time!

updates.title: [Game Update] - 725481
updates.content_text:
Changes
Improved responsiveness of Exploiterator state changes between movement and scanning.
Exploiterator now moves faster when it has a target.
Added missing scrapbook entry for Chessmaster Circuit, Auto-Grabber and Exploiterator.
Bug Fixes
Fixed Possessed Chassis kiting to hold onto their target more intelligently.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not choosing a new target if WX-78 killed the target with Spin-Cycle.
Fixed Rangebooster Circuits on Backup Chassis incorrectly activating for Auto-Grabber without needing Warm Standby perk.
Fixed Dapper Tammie skin sound for equipping it not playing.
Fixed Implanted shadow item not being transferred to the Backup Chassis spawned on death from Inhabited Machine II.
Fixed sometimes being able to craft more Exploiterator or Auto-Grabber drones when reloading a world.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 725134
updates.content_text:
Changes
Auto-Grabber and Exploiterator drones will no longer expire over time or from usage.
Increased Exploiterator limit for Shadow Atrium to 3. (Limit for Possessed Shadow Atrium is 4.)
Increased Exploiterator damage bonus to 6% per drone.
Exploiterator no longer disengages as easily while the target is still in combat with you.
Auto-Grabbers will continue to do work for a Backup Chassis off-screen.
Backup Chassis will no longer be targeted by action button (Spacebar)
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Auto-Grabbers and Exploiterator being slowed down by things like spider webs.
Fixed Auto-Grabber not using the increased range from circuits and Signal Booster when staying with a Backup Chassis.
Fixed crash sometimes when attacking with a Zaptrocuter.
Fixed Wonky feet or tail not staying around when Transferring Consciousness.
Fixed Weather Pain Tornadoes damaging Possessed Chassis.
Fixed Mimicked items sometimes reverting to Mimicreeps when reloading a world or going into or out of the Caves.
Fixed freezing overlay disappearing forever if a Thermal Circuit activates then deactivates.
Fixed Inhabited Machine III not working properly.
Fixed WX-78’s charge bar not gaining charge while it’s overridden by shadow energy.
Fixed Possessed Chassis spawning with 100 of each stat instead of full stats.
Fixed Possessed Chassis having non-full charge.
Fixed Possessed Chassis being left at 1 health when deactivated by its leader.
Fixed Possessed Chassis continuously trying to use a depleted Zaptrocuter Remote.
Fixed Optoelectronics Night vision effect not properly working when activated by the overridden shadow charge.
Fixed Expansive Storage Units being inaccessible in Possessed Chassis.
Fixed the Shadow Mauler being invisible to clients when held by a Possessed Chassis.
Fixed Nutribrick perishing in Icker Preserves when it becomes wet.
Fixed WX-78 trying to eat when implanting fuel into another Backup Chassis.
Fixed being unable to transfer consciousness in the map on controller when a Sonic-Invoker or Blocking Circuit is active.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 724783
updates.content_text:
Changes
Added Chessmaster Circuit.
Replaced Field Survey II skill with Signal Booster skill, which boosts drone range in general rather than just Roto-Mapper.
Roto-Mapper now also functions similar to Ocuvigil, but only revealed to the owner.
Backup Chassis now remembers its stats (e.g. Health, Hunger, Sanity, Beanbooster Shield).
Possessed Chassis changes:
Follow a bit more tightly to the player.
Can be opened to view their inventory.
Repairs Void Cloth, Brightshade, and W.A.R.B.I.S. equipment using kits in their inventory.
Drops part of their eaten gears on death, just like WX-78.
Can now use the Zaptrocuter Controller and aid in combat.
Recognizes attack commands from the leader controlling a Zaptrocuter.
Can raise anchors, lower masts, row, and soak in hot springs with their leader.
Given the ultimate power to copy their leaders' emotes.
Shadow Servitor changes:
Please note that some effects if not listed did not receive major changes, and some have been split between whether you have a type of Shadow Fuel or a type of Shadow Atrium implanted.
Pure Horror can now be implanted into WX-78.
Implanting Nightmare Fuel or Pure Horror unlocks the Auto-Grabber drone, which replaces the shadow harvesting effect.
Implanting Shadow Atrium or Possessed Shadow Atrium unlocks the Exploiterator drone, which replaces the shadow "whip" debuffing effect.
While having any shadow implant, WX-78 can consume Nightmare Fuel or Pure Horror for a short emergency burst of energy. (i.e. Temporarily overrides your battery to max power level; does not recharge your underlying battery level.)
Active temperature circuits will prevent the respective overheating and/or freezing overlays and animations.
Thermal Circuits and Refrigerant Circuits perishing rates now stack (e.g. 2 Refrigerant Circuits means WX-78’s inventory has half perishing rates.)
W.A.R.B.I.S. Armor and Head Gear target lock in range is increased by Rangebooster Circuits with Beta Circuits Tinkering I.
Bio Scanalyzer now ignores walls when pathfinding.
Watering Can can now be used on Nutribricks.
Added unique examination strings for Backup Chassis.
You can now double click in the skill UI to learn the skill.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue with reviving players sliding.
Fixed Processing Circuit’s skill effect applying to negative dapperness items.
Fixed networking issues with temperature going too high if WX-78 has two Thermal Circuits plugged in.
Fixed sanity aura modifier not applying to Beanbooster Circuit with Alpha Circuits Tinkering I.
Fixed Optoelectronic’s circuit effect sticking around when swapping Chassis.
Fixed a case where unplugging a Super-Gastrogain Circuit didn’t fully revert the hunger rate modifier.
Fixed a crash when attacking a Possessed Chassis that is blocking.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not playing the gear eat sound.
Fixed Possessed Chassis missing status and reaction states like electrocuted, knocked back, slipped, etc.
Fixed player-friendly traps (e.g. Tooth Traps) triggering on Possessed Chassis.
Fixed Possessed Chassis going invisible from certain facings when using the Jousting Lance.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not instantly going dormant when unloaded during death or despawn.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not properly inheriting the skins of the Backup Chassis they spawned from.
Fixed a crash when Bio Scanalyzer is hit down by a Catcoon as it’s spitting out Bio Data.
Fixed Watts Up skill effect not applying on initial spawn.
Fixed old evergreens or twiggy trees reappearing again after being chopped by WX-78’s spin.
Fixed WX-78 being possessed by a Void Masque when they should drop a Backup Chassis instead.
Fixed a Void Masqued creature killed by another Void Masqued creature being possessed again by a Void Masque.
Fixed an item duplication bug with Shadow Maxwells.
Weremoose Charge and Werebeaver Tail Slap will no longer hurt allies.
Fixed friendly Grumble Bees attacking friendly Clockworks.
Fixed Malbatross only being able to spawn at 1 shoal on world reload, instead of half of the shoals.
We'll keep an eye out if this causes too many Malbatross fights.
Fixed Woby’s transform state being interrupted by eating.
Fixed the default Beard being shuffled around by the sort filter in the Belongings panel.
Fixed crashing sometimes when Scrappy Werepig’s tackle attack is interrupted.
Fixed Crustashines playing the death sound of a Moleworm when being cooked.
Fixed Clay Vargs and Gingerbread Vargs not being immune to shock.
Fixed a case where dead creature entities persist off-screen.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722832
updates.content_text:
Everyone's favorite soulless automaton is due for an upgrade to ensure their reign of terror over the innocent organics of the Constant continues.
WX-78 Skill Spotlight
The WX-78 skill spotlight is now available on Steam. We want to give shadow affinity part of the skill tree a little more time in beta, and we'll hotfix it in as soon as we have it ready for you. We'll need a few more days for console since we need a new build for console that holds off the shadow affinity portion of the tree. We expect this to be released for console on Monday. We apologize for the inconvenience here, but we think it's worth it for us to make sure Shadow Affinity meets our expectations. 
Highlights
- WX-78 Skill Tree added.
- WX-78 base Circuit system expanded to 3 bars.
- Added several new Circuits.
- Now that Year of the Clockwork Knight is over, players will be limited to 2 (or 3 for WX-78) of each type of Clockwork followers at a time.
New Skins!
“WX-78 Pretty Dark Idolatry Chest” ($5.99 / 12 RMB)
This chest contains the WX-78 Pretty Dark Things Chest, and WX-78's complete set of Archaic skin items.
New Streaming Drops
The “Butterbee" skin for the Beebox has been added to the Chitinous Collection. Check out this post for details.
“Mixing honey and butter, who would have thought?”
Our Ambassadors have also been given a bunch of new codes to give away. Including Starter Packs, and two new Resurrected skins, the Resurrected All-Chemical Engine and Nightmarish Magician's Chest!
Login Reward
If you missed it, we added the Pantomimed Backpack as a login reward on April 1st. Just log in to the game to get yours!
Roadmap!
If you haven't seen it yet, our 2026 roadmap can be found here. 
And that's it for now!
We're finishing up WX-78 and moving on to the Shadow Arc Finale that will be released with our 10 years of DST / 20th Anniversary celebration during Klei Fest in June. See you next time!

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722900
updates.content_text:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a crash when using the skin search filter in the Belongings UI.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not eating food correctly.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722897
updates.content_text:
This hotfix makes the beta branch have the same revision as the default game up to version 722900 for parity.
 
Changes
WX-78's Shadow Servitor perk has been enabled for the beta branch with no changes made to it.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722745
updates.content_text:
Hey guys, just a heads-up regarding tomorrow's update.  We're thinking of keeping the Shadow alignment part of the tree locked, so that we can continue working on it in the beta branch.
Changes
Possessed Chassis
Can now detect actions performed by the player spinning.
Improved kiting behaviour.
Will now try to use max attack range when equipped with a ranged weapon.
Nutribrick is now in the Plant Registry Fertilizers tab and can be properly researched.
Disabled Shadow Servitor skill while it is undergoing some changes.
Disabled Year of the Clockwork Knight.
Like chess, each player is now limited to 2 of each type of Clockwork followers at a time. (WX-78’s limit is 3 per type.)
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Possessed Chassis not being immune to electric damage.
Fixed Possessed Chassis getting stuck in place using Spin-Cycle until they get dizzy.
Fixed Possessed Chassis repeatedly swapping between weapons with the same damage during combat.
Fixed being able to revive by haunting a Possessed Chassis.
Fixed a case where Incursive Gestalts can get stuck when trying to possess a Chassis.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not using the proper animation when attacking with blow darts.
Fixed Possessed Chassis stats not being saved when going dormant.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not dying when their leader dies.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722535
updates.content_text:
Changes
Fine Motor Control and Right To Modify have been combined into a single skill.
Energy-Efficient and Watts Up have been combined into a single skill.
Possessed Chassis changes:
Added visual FX.
Can now hop on and off of boats.
Will re-equip a weapon when their currently held weapon breaks.
Can be given items to be stored in their inventory.
Will switch to the necessary tool to perform an action if it’s within their inventory.
Will equip the best weapon based on damage when switching to fight a target.
Will now automatically eat food from their own inventory.
Boat leaks will now wet items.
Added scrapbook entry for Spectral Transfer Module
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where dormant Possessed Chassis may have required the player to travel between Forest/Caves twice for it to reactivate.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not being able to use speed modifiers from equipped items.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not being able to kite on boats.
Fixed Gestalts sometimes getting stuck when trying to possess a Chassis.
Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when kiting with Possessed Chassis.
Fixed Spatializer Circuit being under Storage subcategory in the scrapbook.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722310
updates.content_text:
Changes
Updated art on Backup Chassis and Circuit UI based on the Implanted Shadow item.
Possessed Chassis changes:
Kiting behaviour improved to match the distance of the player to the target.
Stops moving when the player is attempting to feed them.
Automatically re-equips tools and armor from their inventory when one breaks.
NOTE: re-equipping weapons did not make it into this build yet.
Reverts to dormant Chassis when the player logs off or travels between Forest/Caves, and automatically reactivates to Possessed Chassis when the player returns.
KNOWN ISSUE: If you are playing alone on the server, you may have to travel back and forth between Forest/Caves twice for this to work right now.
Added FX to differentiate between regular death vs. sanity depletion.
No longer drops inventory upon death.
Spectral Transfer Module will drop out once a Gestalt successfully possesses the Chassis, allowing it to be reused.
KNOWN ISSUE: Possessed Chassis saved in previous Beta version may not function properly, and may need to be manually removed.
Hammers can no longer be used with Spin-Cycle Circuit, only Axes and Pickaxes.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where WX-78 could be targeted by Enlightened Crown Gestalts spawned by their own Possessed Chassis.
Fixed Possessed Chassis being able to equip other character-exclusive items.
Fixed Possessed Chassis losing all the inventory from the Backup Chassis.
Fixed Possessed Chassis not properly moving when trying to sync with your actions.
Fixed a crash when Possessed Chassis enters tree shade.
Fixed crashes with Backup Chassis related to socketholder component.
Fixed a crash sometimes when Bearger is interrupted during combo attacks.
Fixed a crash sometimes when interrupted during spin attack.
Fixed slipperiness failing to accumulate while spinning on ice.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 722057
updates.content_text:
Changes
Added Lunar and Shadow alignment skills.
NOTE: Visual FX will be added later to Chassis affected by Lunar alignment skill.
Incursive Gestalts can now be encapsulated.
Reduced the cooldowns of Sonic-Invoker Circuit and Blocking Circuit to 20 seconds.
WX-78 in the blocking state will now taunt creatures attacking their allies.
Reduce Biodata cost in Illumination Circuit to 2 biodata.
Reduced Nutribricks fuel value, and raised its farm nutrient value.
Spin-Cycle Circuit:
All Axes, Pickaxes, and Hammers can now be used, but will recoil when hitting the wrong target.
The first swing of the attack is less likely to miss now, unless the target is running away.
Added FX to indicate level of dizziness buildup.
Stacking Circuits increases dizziness buildup time from 8s to 12s.  (Recovery time stays the same.)
Changes to tool consumption:
Further reduced tool consumption for every target beyond the first, per swing.
Stacking Circuits eliminates tool consumption for all targets beyond the first, per swing.  (The first target costs one regular usage.)
Pick action costs a small fixed amount of usage per swing, regardless of how many targets.
Updated Scrapbook to include new Circuits, what creatures to scan for them, and how the Circuitry skills affect them.
Controller support for Circuit UI.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Electrification Circuit’s skill perk damaging walls.
Fixed Beanboosters shield regenerating at a rate of 0.07 per second instead of 0.25 per second.
Fixed Nutribrick to properly disappear when it spoils.
Fixed Shadow Maul lifesteal incorrectly being scaled down when stacking Spin-Cycle Circuits.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 721079
updates.content_text:
Changes
Irreplaceable items will no longer go into a Backup Chassis and will fall out when WX-78 Transfers Consciousness.
Electrification Circuit direct damage reduction has been reverted.
Gastrogain circuits hunger drain changed so the base rate is the same before the skill tree perks.
Blocking Circuit
Reduced cooldown from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.
Increased the damage it can take from 75 to 100.
We are considering adding a taunt effect later.
Slightly increased Sonic-Invoker Circuit’s panic time.
Spin-Cycle circuit
The spinning action is now an AOE effect.
Added controlled movement while spinning.  Movement speed is affected by speed boosts.
Spinning for too long will result in a brief dizzy state.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Backup Chassis created from Inhabited Machines II having a fully charged energy meter.
Fixed W.O.B.O.T. picking up just one item at a time and returning to store it.
Fixed Electrification Circuit’s skill perk not taking into account electric damage multipliers and wetness.
Fixed Electrification Circuit’s skill perk interrupting WX-78’s block state.
Fixed Spoiled foods (e.g. Spoiled Meatballs) not giving any stats to a WX-78 with Redigestion Circuit and its skill perk.
Fixed WX-78 with Gamma Circuits being unable to dismount from their mount.
 
Modding Notes
Added support for more fields in WX-78 module definitions.
overridebank, overridebuild, overrideminiuibuild, overrideuibuild

updates.title: [Game Update] - 720809
updates.content_text:
Changes
Added 4 Gamma Circuits: Redigestion, Sonic-Invoker, Spin-Cycle, Blocking.
Spin-Cycle requires having an Axe equipped to Chop or Attack.  Strings will be updated later to make that more apparent.
Cooldown indicators for Sonic-Invoker and Blocking Circuits are shown on the expanded Circuit bars.  These will be made easier to see later without needing to open the bar.
Revised Circuit Tinkering Skill descriptions.
All water projectiles (Waterballoons, Ink, Water globs) will now add moisture to items.
Circuit tuning:
Hardy circuits provide less health overall.
Hunger drain benefits with Gastrogain circuits are reduced.
The dapper clothing sanity gains from Processing circuits with Alpha Circuit Tinkering II has been reduced.
Beanbooster circuit no longer increases the passive health regeneration with Alpha Circuits Tinkering I.
Illumination circuits cone light has been adjusted to be smaller overall from Beta Circuit Tinkering II.
Electrification Circuit direct damage has been reduced, and the explosion damage from Beta Circuits Tinkering II has been reduced.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed a crash when a Marotter steals an item.
Fixed a crash when feeding a Pig Man.
Fixed a desync between server and client player movement speed with Vigor Mortis buff and Acceleration Circuits skill perk.
Fixed Expansive Storage Unit not functioning properly when transferred into a Backup Chassis.
Fixed cases where you could still Move/Drop the Expansive Storage Unit using a controller.
Fixed Bright-Beaked Birds still spawning when they’re disabled in world settings.
Fixed an issue where corpses could persist, even when there’s no Crystal-Crested Buzzards nearby.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 719586
updates.content_text:
Hey everyone. Small update patch for today. We wanted to give out a backpack filled to the brim with haute air. It is a guarantee that your Survivor will be more visible when using this backpack compared to any other.
While we are working hard to get the WX-78 skill tree beta finished for you all to enjoy, we would like to thank everyone who has or still is testing the beta. Your reports and feedback are invaluable. See you next time!

updates.title: [Game Update] - 719857
updates.content_text:
Hey guys, we've been trying to finish up some of the more tech heavy changes needed, especially with the Spatializer Circuit, to get that out in a hotfix before the weekend.  We're still working on the remaining skills, but next week we will also put some focus on retuning the current Circuits.  To be honest, it is very likely that we will be adjusting down their effects overall.  It may not be a popular change immediately, but we feel some rebalancing is necessary, and the sooner we can get feedback on it the better.  Huge thanks to everyone currently in the Beta!
Changes
Roto-Mapper can now be selected even if it is out of range from WX-78, but can only be sent back to destinations within range.
Spatializer Circuit changes:
Expansive Storage Unit now stays installed as long as the circuit is plugged in.
Can only be opened if the corresponding circuit is powered.
Can no longer be moved or dropped.
No longer requires the player to be stationary to keep it open.
Players may need to Unplug and reinstall their circuits in existing beta save files for these changes to take proper effect.
Updated art to help distinguish between Circuit types (Alpha, Beta, etc.)
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed bug with Riled Abigail not targeting properly.
B.U.D.D.Y. will now tend to nearby farm plants.
Fixed a crash with the Illumination Circuits while teleporting in the Sanctum.
Fixed WX-78’s Circuit actions not networked properly on clients.
Fixed a crash that sometimes happened when unplugging circuits.
Fixed night vision improperly updating with the Optoelectronic Circuit and Moggles.
Fixed Thermal Circuit steam fx alignment on Backup Chassis and while mounted on a Beefalo.
Fixed Backup Chassis highlighting on the Map after swapping to another character.
Fixed Circuits showing up as unpowered after Transferring Consciousness in the HUD UI.
Fixed W.O.B.O.T., W.I.N.bot, and Woby from trying to store items inside of a Backup Chassis.
Fixed a crash with Buzzards attacking.
Fixed players saying the wrong phrase when trying to shave Woodie.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 719209
updates.content_text:
Changes
Rangebooster Circuit’s skill perk now boosts Bio Scanalyzer’s scanning range.
Zaptrocuter recipe is now unlocked directly with the skill, and no longer requires obtaining via Bio Scanalyzer.
Backup Chassis will now use the increased energy level from the owning WX-78.
Backup Chassis will no longer drop its crafting ingredients when being hammered.
Reduced the armor from Hardy Circuit’s skill perk.
Roto-Mappers can now be sent over the Abyss in the Caves.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a crash when Transferring Consciousness when having a Luxury tool or Umbrella equipped.
Fixed a crash when haunting a Backup Chassis.
Fixed equipped items on the Backup Chassis not dropping when being hammered.
Fixed a crash when deactivating a Bio Scanalyzer while it’s dropping bio data.
Fixed an issue where the Bio Scanalyzer can become stuck after a successful scan.
Fixed WX-78’s circuit bar display being reversed.
Fixed WX-78’s current shield not being saved when loading the game.
Fixed Charge action for Zaptrocuter Controller or Morning Star failing for WX-78 on clients with prediction.
Fixed a crash when Zaptrocuter breaks Marotter Den.
Fixed crashing sometimes when interrupted while trying to activate Zaptrocuter.
Fixed camera not focused properly after using Zaptrocuter on a Boat.
Fixed Catcoonalyzer skin not playing its custom sound effects.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 719036
updates.content_text:
Changes
Swapped the Skill Perk effects of the Refrigerant Circuit and Thermal Circuit.
Reordered WX-78’s crafting recipes.
Reduced WX-78’s base stats to 100 health, 100 hunger, and 100 sanity.
Minor adjustments to Zaptrocuter camera and movement acceleration.
Zaptrocuter attack button can now be held for repeated attacks.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Zaptrocuter not responding to held movement controls after firing on clients with prediction.
Fixed getting stuck on a black screen sometimes when damaged during transfer to a Backup Chassis.
Fixed a crash when food rots in a Backup Chassis, and other item related issues with it.
We apologize, but as a side effect of this fix, Backup Chassis saved prior to this hotfix will lose their skins and equipped items.
Fixed bug where Beta circuits remained active on Backup Chassis of a player that has left the server.
Fixed a crash on closing WX-78’s circuit bar menu.
Fixed max health not being properly synced to clients when plugging in the Hardy Circuit.
Fixed the Optoelectronic Circuit not functioning properly.
Fixed the Beanbooster Circuit instantly healing to full rather than overtime.
Fixed Alpha circuits not properly disappearing off the Circuit bar UI when transferring consciousness.
Jousting will now be properly interrupted when the weapon is unequipped.
 
Known Issues
The action to recharge Zaptrocuter Controller or Morning Star fails for WX-78 on clients with prediction.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 718478
[Game Update] - 718694
updates.content_text:
Small hotfix for issues found from the skins.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a crash when searching for certain recipes in the crafting menu.
Fixed Gustree Helm trying to hide the player's hair when worn.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 718778
updates.content_text:
Hey everyone, a new beta has just been released!
This focus of this beta is the Skill Spotlight for WX-78.  Some skills are still marked as "Coming soon", and will be added during this beta.  Some mechanics will still go through further tuning, such as creatures lacking behavior to deal with attacks from outside their aggro range.
Instructions for accessing the beta branch can be found here.  As always, things may be changed or retuned, and we'll be looking forward to your feedback during beta.
 
Notes for Modders
The mod release ID for this patch is R41_ST_WX78.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 714014
updates.content_text:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a crash related to the Deck Of Cards.
Fixed networking exploit with tripping while galloping on clients.
Fixed world settings incorrectly affecting Nightmare Light and Nightmare Fissure creature spawns.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 713564
updates.content_text:
Bug Fixes
Shtick Horse will no longer slow you down if you were already faster than its speed boost.
Fixed cases where repaired or previously befriended Clockworks did not follow you sometimes.
Fixed Chester, Glommer, Polly Rogers, and others from getting detached from their items when attacked.
Fixed bug with Spiders attacking a Chester that is following Webber.
Fixed bug related to unlucky players’ effects on Hound waves.
Fixed bug with Lightning Strikes incorrectly affecting nearby Torches and Morning Stars.
Fixed crashes related to Crystal-Crested Buzzard.
Fixed art bugs with Glommer's Fairy Glom and Marble Impact Armor skins.
Fixed Bishop scrapbook entries showing incorrect damage values.

Winter's Feast

A new upgrade tier for Pearl’s Place after meeting certain conditions, with customizable slots for Wind Charm decorations.
New structures that can be crafted for Pearl after meeting certain conditions, including a Tea Shop, Hot Spring, Large Drying Rack, Light Post, Rocking Chair, and Combriner.

Streaming Drop!

Festive Holiday Attire

See you next year!

Shortly after we return we're be working to release the next Lunar New Year event and on to our next big update. Have a great Winter's Feast everybody!

updates.title: [Game Update] - 692645

Hey  Everybody!
We have a couple of surprises for you today. 
First, we have a Follow-Up release for the "From Beyond - Ancient Echoes" update!
Highlights Include:
Items pulled down the giant whirlpool are now grouped in a single pile that can be rummaged to retrieve them.
Replaced the path to one of the Fountain rooms with a new puzzle room in the Sanctum.
Ruins and Sanctum Relics can now be used as furniture decoration.
Geothermite creature found in the Fumarole biome
Login Reward
We're also adding the “Bearger Fur Roll” skin for the Fur Roll. Simply log in to the game to claim it. 
And - one other special thing. 
We've been quietly working on something special for you to tie up some loose threads with the Don't Starve lore. For a while now, we have been handling lore mostly through game content and Intermissions, but starting now, we'll also be periodically presenting some extra hidden lore content for you. Sometimes this may be a simple comic, or it may be something a little more... interesting. We want to ease you back into things, so we'll keep it simple.
Extra resources for delivering lore have always been somewhat of a challenge. Sometimes it takes us longer than other times. Planning time and the effort required can be hard to justify for something that is sort of just for fun. Especially when we have something we are trying to convey in the lore. Coordinating things in such a way that is worth our time and yours has always been a labour of love. Together, we have come up with some new methods to make this fun and engaging for all of us. As you will see, this will come in different forms and at different times. Many of you will be interested. Understandably, some of you may not. Still, we hope that the result is more of lore that you love and a fun way to pass the time between updates. 
You now have everything you need to begin! Once you think you have found it. You haven't. Look further - but somewhere else. Think back to how we did things before and do it again.

updates.title: [Game Update] - 687866
updates.content_text:
Hey everyone, a new beta just released!
It is worth noting that this is not the "final update" for this arc. We originally had plans to try and quickly wrap things up for this arc in a couple of updates, but as many have suspected, that's not quite going to work. Instead, we took this opportunity to prepare some of the more tech heavy parts first, as well as added another shadow thrall for the rifts.
Instructions for accessing the beta branch can be found here.  As always, things may be changed or retuned during beta, and we'll be looking for feedback during beta.
Additions
Added a Fumarole area where an old companion of the Ancients will appear during the Shadow Rift.
Note: This area is not retrofitted yet. It will be in a later hotfix.
Added a Giant Whirlpool which tends to pull everything down with it.
Caves must be enabled for it to appear.
Added hidden rooms in the Caves that can be explored to uncover Ancient lore, that is if you can find the entrance…
 
Changes
Brightshade/Corpse Gestalts are now known as Incursive Gestalts.
 
Quality of Life
Woodie’s Wooden Walking Stick no longer consumes durability when its wearer is not moving.
Birds now have death sounds.
Bird sounds will disappear from the turf ambience for most of the Post-Lunar Hail period.
 
Bug Fixes
Fixed Crabby Hermit eating your ocean fish instead of giving them back.
Fixed network deserialization issues with the T.I.N.G.L.E. Node's field.
Fixed missing examination strings for the Sentimental Adornments.
Fixed Hutch turning invisible when trying to go into his electrocute state.
Fixed Mimicked Construction Amulets providing one use before being revealed.
Fixed recipes crafted from Mimicked ingredients appearing at the world's origin.
Fixed Batilisks being unable to wake up when put to sleep.
 
Notes for modders
The mod release ID for this patch is R39_WHIRL_VAULT.
Fixed 'entitysleep' and 'entitywake' events being pushed twice for entities.
Some more changes have been made for mod loading and font loading, please let us know if you experience mods breaking in the beta from loading.
A new component for shard to shard data transfers that need to be reliable has been added and is being tested for this beta called shardtransactionsteps.
Brains
inst.brain:Start/Stop is deprecated
Use inst:StopBrain(reason) and inst:RestartBrain(reason) instead.
These changes will help the brain and state graph stay started/stopped properly based on all the different systems that may control it (Freezing, Sleeping, Drowning)

updates.title: [Game Update] - 681436
updates.content_text:
Hey all, it's time for Intermission! This time for you we've got a mysterious animation, new login reward, streaming drops, and "Hostile Takeover: Phase Two"!
Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Forgone
It’s easy to lose ourselves in dreams of what might have been. But reality creeps in, quiet and inevitable like shadows at dusk. As the shadow arc draws to a close, every promise must be honored, every debt paid.
Hostile Takeover: Phase 2
We have some additional content and features for Hostile Takeover that were released in the update today. 
Highlights include:
Electric weapons adjusted, and shock states added to creatures.
Added a new craftable T.I.N.G.L.E. Node.
Drying Rack changed to have multiple slots.
Celestial Altar crafting adjustments.
Post Celestial Scion adjustments to Lunar questline.
Lunar Hail optimizations, and the falling debris has been replaced with a new event and mutation.
Rendering optimizations.
Streaming Drops!
The Marble Star-Studded Armor skin for the Marble Suit has been added to the Orbital Collection. Check out the post for more details.
Login Reward
 
For a limited time players will receive the Mythic Bone Helm just by logging into the game. This is a limited-time item, don't miss out!
Board Game Update!
Our Friends at Glass Cannon Unplugged have updated the Dont Starve The Board Game project page with new images and info. They'll be launching in September. Follow the campaign to stay up to date on future launch details and to get a free gift if you decide to support the project!
Also. from July 31st to August 3rd they are also at Gen Con with a playable demo. If you're attending, stop by, sit down, and see if you can survive.
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/glasscannonunplugged/dont-starve-the-board-game
That's it for now!
We're well on our way to the next update that will be coming in September, and we'll have some more information for you about that pretty soon. Have fun out there!

Changes

updates.title: [Game Update] - 677072
[Game Update] - 676724
updates.content_text:
Hey everyone.
We have some changes that could break loading or saving for some mods. We are requesting the help of testers to see if anything breaks with their unique setups: World creation, dedicated server hosting, normal gameplay, modded sessions for anything, etc. The more that can be thrown at the game to try to break it the better.
Early in the development of Don't Starve Together, we had created utility functions with a wide variety of potential use cases as a blanket to let the designers work without too many limitations. We have recently re-evaluated these functions and how they could be used in unintended ways. The changes introduced in this beta have been made to mitigate any potential harmful effects the misuse of these functions might cause.
If you encounter any mod related issues in this beta but works outside of the beta please let us know what that mod is with either a crash log or what stopped functioning in it. You can find your relevant crash log files using our helper article at: https://support.klei.com/hc/en-us/articles/360029881191-Logs-and-Useful-Information-for-Bug-Reports-for-Don-t-Starve-Together
While this beta is leaning towards players who use mods, any testing done is appreciated even if you do not use mods.

updates.content_text:
Wagstaff, the Cryptic Founder, has always pushed the boundaries of this unnatural world. It’s no surprise when the world pushes back — culminating in a cataclysmic conclusion to the lunar arc.
The Hostile Takeover update is live on Steam now. The console release has been delayed about a week and we will have it for Xbox and PlayStation as soon as we can. We'll post more details when we get them.  
Highlights Include:
New boss and conclusion to the Lunar questline
Wandering Trader
Ocean drowning QoL
Structure Alignment options
New controller scheme options
As always, we'll also be bringing new skins, new streaming drops, a special Klei Fest login reward, and more!

If you want to get one of those for free, check out our Ambassadors that are giving them away!

Login Rewards!

Steaming Drops!
The Gathering Amulet skin for the Lazy Forager starts our new Orbital Collection. Check out the post for more details.
Klei Fest!
Our annual publisher sale is back! We've got a bunch of updates and discounts for you. 
An free base game update for Oxygen Not Included including bug fixes, QOL changes, and a new building!
The Release of The Prehistoric Planet Pack DLC for Oxygen Not Included
The Lowest prices ever for many Klei Entertainment games
Including the Klei Fest Bundle for an additional 50% off!
Announcing Away Team - A new game set in the Oxygen Not Included Universe!
Localization updates for Lab Rat
Beastieball has a big new Milestone update including new team titles, new language support, new Beastie animations and more!
Rift of the Necrodancer + Hatsune Miku DLC release. 6 songs + 1 free track!
Check out the sale page here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2025
We've also announced our new game - Away Team!
Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated.
Mistakenly shipped off on a research rocket, you find yourself in a strange new world where you must take control of the simulation to survive and thrive.
The world reacts to your every action. Harness chemical reactions, fine-grained temperature simulation and convection, liquids that evaporate, and more.
You will need to design and construct solutions to process, refine and build your way out of this ordeal in order to survive and complete your mission imperatives.
Oh, and maybe a little oxygen is included.
Check it out on Steam and Wishlist now!
That's all for now!
Klei Fest is now in full swing, but we aren't quite finished with what we wanted to get in for this update, so you can look forward to a little bit more hitting beta some time soon. After that, we're back at it for an update we expect in mid-September, and of course, with an intermission about 6 weeks from now.
We'll see you soon!

updates.content_text:

Added in Celestial Scion’s death sequence.
